🚨🇮🇷 IRAN PROTESTERS: “THEY’RE MASSACRING US, BUT WE’RE NOT GOING ANYWHERE”

Footage coming out of Iran shows streets packed with protesters last night: chanting, marching, risking everything.

This is despite over 100 hours of internet blackout, reports of thousands killed, and https://t.co/eSpcT8YV0k
